Method of Attack: Phishing campaign using legitimate enterprise cloud services (Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM Cloud) to host phishing landing pages and steal login credentials
Emails sent with spoofed 'From:' address matching the domain in the last 'Received:' header to bypass spam filters
Use of legitimate SSL certificates from cloud providers to add credibility
Phishing emails contain buttons redirecting to Microsoft Dynamics 365 URL then to IBM Cloud domain hosting phishing page
Landing page validates password complexity before redirecting to fake confirmation page on Microsoft Azure domain
Final redirect to victim's email domain website
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with spoofed sender domain
Use of legitimate cloud hosting services for phishing landing pages
Email spoofing exploiting lack of DMARC, DKIM, SPF on servicedesk.com domain
Indicators of Compromise: Originating domain in headers: servicedesk.com (IP 104.37.188.73, not live)
Phishing landing page domains: cf.appdomain.cloud (IBM Cloud), windows.net (Microsoft Azure)
